summary: Reports project isolation tested end-to-end (backend pytest 23/24 + Playwright UI). All project-scoping works: projects-activity endpoint correct (مطعم الاختبار 33 orders / 932,250; other 8 projects has_data=false); /reports/sales with project_id or X-Project-Id of empty project returns 0; branch of another project returns 0; all tab endpoints (expenses, profit-loss, products, products-by-channel, delivery-credits, cancellations, discounts, credit, card, purchases, inventory, refunds, smart-reports) return zero for empty project. UI: with 'كل المشاريع' + 2026-06-01..07-31 the strip shows 9 chips (REST green 932,250 IQD · 33, 8 red 'لا توجد بيانات'), dropdown shows 8 red dots (none on مطعم الاختبار). Selecting صالون الأناقة by chip or dropdown refetches immediately with X-Project-Id and shows 0 everywhere across all 9 tabs; REST shows its data; switching back to all re-aggregates; rapid switching ends in correct state (no stale data); selection persists across reload. Only gap: Products (الأصناف) tab lists the whole tenant catalog (34 products incl. other projects' products) with 0 sold for an empty project.

minor.issue: Product catalog is not scoped by project: for صالون الأناقة (empty) it returns total_products=34 including مطعم الاختبار/البرغر/الشاورما products (with 0 sold). products have project_id field, so product_query should be filtered by selected project (_PROJECT_SCOPE project_id). Sales numbers themselves are correctly 0.
Resets scope to None and returns ALL projects' sales even for project-restricted users (user_project_scope). Should limit to the user's project when restricted.

Pre-existing inconsistency (not project-related): profit-loss counts 53 orders / 1,032,250 (includes 20 pending orders) while sales counts 33 / 932,250. Sales tab 'صافي الربح' card shows 943,250 which is greater than total sales 932,250.

ui_bugs.issue: For an empty project, the table shows other projects' products (برغر كلاسيك, برغر دبل...) with 0 qty — caused by backend catalog not being project-scoped

issues: 'لا توجد بيانات' text hardcoded (not wrapped in t()) — will not translate in EN mode

action_items: Scope product catalog in /api/reports/products (and products-by-channel catalog if any) to the selected project's products (product.project_id == scope.project_id) when a project is selected
In /api/reports/projects-activity, restrict to user's project when user_project_scope(current_user) is set
(Optional, pre-existing) align profit-loss order filter with sales report (exclude pending/unpaid) so Net Profit card <= sales

(Optional) wrap 'لا توجد بيانات' in t() in ProjectsActivityStrip.jsx; consider AbortController/request-id guard in fetchReports to avoid out-of-order responses on slow networks (rapid switching passed in test)
critical_code_review_comments: _PROJECT_SCOPE ContextVar set by async router dependency works since deps run in same task; every request sets it, so no cross-request leakage
_scope: when branch_id is a non-str (e.g. dict $in) it is ignored and $or project cond is appended — fine; when branch_id str not in project it forces empty $in — verified
Reports.js is ~6000 lines — should be split into tab components
fetchReports has no cancellation; stale response could overwrite newer one under latency

success_rate.backend: 96% (23/24; failing test documents product catalog leak)
